notes: «حدثنا أبي» is a bare relation (rule 7); the blessing «رحمه الله» is left out.
«بإسناد متصل إلى الصادق» names the Imam inside the chain, after «إلى», so he is a narrator as the last link (not imam_in_text, which is for words after the chain).

fixes.reason: The text's chain ends at al-Sadiq, but the THQ English sanad for this report runs through Sulaim b. Qays to the Commander of the Believers; the two do not agree on the transmitter.

evidence.quote: from Sulaim bin Qais al-Hilali, from the Commander of the Believers
